svg.title: Azure Cars Data Engineering Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end Azure data engineering architecture: SQL source ingested via Data Factory into a Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architecture on ADLS Gen2, transformed in Databricks, served as Star Schema, visualized in Power BI, with security via Azure Active Directory and Key Vault.
svg.text: 1 · SQL data ingested incrementally via ADF pipelines linked to GitHub
2 · Raw Parquet files land in Bronze (ADLS Gen2) → Databricks cleans to Silver → Delta Lake in Gold
3 · Synapse Analytics builds Star Schema → Power BI consumes Gold for dashboards
